jobs.prompt: Create an ORIGINAL detailed realistic hand-painted fantasy equipment MATERIAL TEXTURE for Alvorada Cinzenta's established native item-skin library. Square closeup of dark tempered steel with very refined antique copper and warm ivory-silver inlaid arcane circuitry. Original interlocking small hexagonal channels, engraved short nested star segments and tiny sapphire mineral inclusions; physically tactile metal, polished narrow edge glints, subtle teal patina in recessed seams, rich and legible craft on a dark shop background. Evoke a weapon containing a low-level spell with precise restrained runic workmanship. No copied symbols, written glyphs or actual letters. Fill the ENTIRE square edge to edge, no transparent regions, frame, border, background scene, isolated weapon, person, text, watermark, logo or generic colored smoke. This is a unique material identity, not a recolor of an existing texture.
